verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a SaaS virtual-mailbox platform, and a product of this kind could plausibly ship an API with official SDKs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an SDK, API or developer documentation. The probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path and no llms.txt, and the docs describe only phone-app and web-portal access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
